# mxroute_reseller_package (Resource)

Manage a reseller hosting package through a **plain reseller** provider (not an impersonation alias). Limits use strings so `unlimited` and `0` stay distinct; package quota is in GB, unlike user quota in MB. Only configured, changed limits are sent on update. Whether package updates change existing users' effective quota is live-unverified. Delete fails while users are assigned (the error is surfaced and no user is removed); reference the package from `mxroute_reseller_user.package` so Terraform removes users first. Import with the exact package name. Runtime behavior is live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use a plain reseller provider, not a reseller|user impersonation alias.
resource "mxroute_reseller_package" "starter" {
  name             = "starter"
  quota_gb         = "5" # GB, or "unlimited"
  domains          = "3"
  email_accounts   = "0" # no customer mailboxes; distinct from "unlimited"
  email_forwarders = "unlimited"
  # Omitted limits adopt the server value (documented creation defaults).
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Package name of letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Case is preserved and compared exactly; a case-only variant of an existing package is rejected. Changing it replaces the package, which fails while users are assigned.

### Optional

- `domain_pointers` (String) Domain pointer limit, or `unlimited`. Documented creation default `10`. Omission adopts the server value and later updates preserve it.
- `domains` (String) Domain limit, or `unlimited`. Documented creation default `1`. Omission adopts the server value and later updates preserve it.
- `email_accounts` (String) Usable customer mailbox limit, or `unlimited`. `0` permits no customer mailboxes and is distinct from `unlimited`; the system mailbox does not consume this allowance. Documented creation default `100`. Omission adopts the server value and later updates preserve it.
- `email_forwarders` (String) Forwarder limit, or `unlimited`. Documented creation default `100`. Omission adopts the server value and later updates preserve it.
- `quota_gb` (String) Disk quota in **GB**, or `unlimited`. Documented creation default `1`. Omission adopts the server value and later updates preserve it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Package name; account-relative to the plain reseller provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_reseller_package.starter starter
```
